items.title: Dior board clears Agache merger to tighten Arnault grip on LVMH
items.why: Ownership consolidation at LVMH is not a partner signal, but watch for any brand-level strategy shifts that follow.
items.summary_ai: Dior's board approved a merger with Agache, the Arnault family holding company, deepening family control of LVMH.
items.take: Ownership consolidation at LVMH is not a partner signal, but watch for any brand-level strategy shifts that follow.
